passive.name: Knight's Rite
passive.text:
When the equipper's **Basic Attack** or **EX Special Attack**'s heavy attack hits an enemy, they gain 1 stack of **Battle Edge**, increasing CRIT DMG by **32/36.8/41.6/46.4/51.2%** for 25s. **Battle Edge** can stack up to 2 times, and each skill type can provide up to 1 stack. Repeated triggers refresh the duration of all **Battle Edge**.
At 2 stacks of **Battle Edge**, the equipper gains **Bonechill**: Their DMG ignores **20/23/26/29/32%** of the target's **Ice RES**.

The 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear** is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Converging Spear
entries.text:
While in the Aerial Patrol Spear state and **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** can be used, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Launches the corresponding **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** based on the current stage, dealing **Ice DMG**.
**Basic Attack: Converging Spear** has three stages. Each use advances it to the next stage. After performing the third stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**, it resets to the first stage.
If Sigrid is attacked while charging the 1st or 2nd stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**, she blocks with her shield. On a successful block, the attack's DMG is negated, the next **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** deals 100% more Daze, the Aerial Patrol Spear state is refreshed, and she gains one use of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**. Press Basic Attack after a successful block to perform the corresponding stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**.
**Basic Attack: Converging Spear** performed after **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear** retains the current stage of **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear**.
DMG taken is reduced by 60% during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable during the third stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**.

entries.name: Dodge: Cloudstep
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Windchase
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Performs a forward cleaving slash, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Counterthrust
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Condenses frost around the spearhead before unleashing a powerful counterattack, dealing **Ice DMG**.
When performed after **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear**, **Dodge Counter: Counterthrust** retains the current stage of **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear**.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Iron Sentinel
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Condenses ice before lunging forward, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Dauntless Cold
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Devouring Frost
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Swings the spear upward before following with a powerful downward attack, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Frostflower
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Performs three forward thrusts, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade
entries.text:
With enough Energy and while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Performs a series of powerful stabs ahead, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
When **EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade** is chained after **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear**, **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear**'s hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade
entries.text:
With enough Energy and while in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Performs a series of powerful lunging stabs ahead, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
When **EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade** is chained after **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear**, **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear**'s hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a powerful piercing attack against enemies ahead, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
Upon activating this skill, gains the **Tempered** effect, increasing the DMG dealt by subsequent **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** attacks by 20% for 50s.
When the current skill hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, the current stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** is recorded and then reset before entering the Formation Breaker state. While in Formation Breaker, Aerial Patrol Spear's duration will not be reduced. Hold Basic Attack to continuously activate the 1st through 3rd stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**. After activating the 3rd stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**, Formation Breaker ends and **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**'s stage is restored to the recorded stage.
Formation Breaker can trigger at most once against the same target before the target recovers from Stun.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
While in the Formation Breaker state, **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** does not trigger the Chain Attack window when hitting Stunned enemies.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Frozen Heavens
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Gathers the power of extreme cold before unleashing a devastating series of lunging attacks, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Sky Knight
entries.text:
The 4th hit of **Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear**, **EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade**, **EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade**, **Assist Follow-Up: Devouring Frost**, **Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice**, **Ultimate: Frozen Heavens**, and **Dodge Counter: Counterthrust** are considered Unbridled Spear attacks.
Whenever Sigrid hits an enemy with any Unbridled Spear in combat while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, she enters the Aerial Patrol Spear state and gains 1 use of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** that cannot be stacked.
While in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, when Sigrid hits an enemy with an Unbridled Spear skill, the Aerial Patrol Spear state is refreshed and she gains 1 use of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** that cannot be stacked.
When triggering or refreshing Aerial Patrol Spear, its duration decreases as the stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** increases. At stage 1/2/3, its duration is **8**/**7**/**6**s.
When Aerial Patrol Spear ends, the stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** is reduced by one, to a minimum of stage 1.
Activating or refreshing Aerial Patrol Spear increases Sigrid's CRIT Rate by **66%** for **8**s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by **8**s, up to a maximum of **40**s.
When Sigrid hits a Stunned enemy while in Aerial Patrol Spear, the Stun DMG Multiplier of her DMG dealt to the target is increased by 20%.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Legion of the Skies
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Support** or **Stun** character:
Sigrid's ATK increases by 120. This effect scales with character level, with each level providing an additional increase of 12, up to a maximum increase of 840.
DMG increases by **15%** when hitting enemies in the **Contamination** state.

entries.name: Long, Long Ago
entries.text:
Upon activating the 3rd stage of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**, enters the **Aerial Patrol Spear** and gains 1 additional activation of **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**.
When activations exceed the stored **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**'s activation limit, the next **Basic Attack: Converging Spear**'s final hit deals an additional **100%** of ATK as **Ice DMG**.
Sigrid's **ATK** increases by **25%**.

entries.name: Legend's First Act
entries.text:
PEN Ratio of **Unbridled Spear** attacks and **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** increases by **24%**.
The duration of **Aerial Patrol Spear** is extended by 2s. Sigrid's Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%.

**Formation Breaker** state's **Basic Attack: Converging Spear** will activate faster.
